profile.name: Arnab Kayal
profile.intro: My research focuses on developing spectral projection methods for solving integral and integro-differential equations. I also study spectral approximations of integral operators; neural integral and integral and integro-differential equations with spectral solvers.
profile.researchLine: Spectral Projection Methods · Integral Equations · Scientific Computing
